appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Browser Usage Share by Product'
Vertical axis labeled with numbers from 0 to 100 in increments of 10.
Horizontal axis labeled with browser product names: 'Chrome', 'Safari', 'Edge', 'Firefox', 'Others'.
Purple bar, labeled '73%', positioned above the 'Chrome' label on the x-axis.
Red bar, labeled '12%', positioned above the 'Safari' label on the x-axis.
Green bar, labeled '2%', positioned above the 'Edge' label on the x-axis.
Blue bar, labeled '6%', positioned above the 'Firefox' label on the x-axis.
Orange bar, labeled '7%', positioned above the 'Others' label on the x-axis.
